usa-business-migration-planner 0.1.0

- Initial release of the USA Business Migration Planner skill.
- Provides a repeatable workflow for handling options to use a Waffle menu or display links normally, validated by multiple online signals.
- Outputs tailored answers, reusable checklists, or workflows for software improvement requests focused on menu and link display options.
- Ensures every output includes summary verification and clear assumptions for user action.
- Designed for local and resource-friendly implementation, minimizing reliance on large-scale cloud solutions.
